frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole organism: small head, barrel trunk, crossbar-bearing dorsal sail. Not skeletal replica or renamed Dimetrodon.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: AMNH FR7003 confirms named genus reference; visual anatomy uses Museum of Evolution published E.boanerges skeletal display photograph. Display image has no catalogue number and is NOT asserted to be FR7003.

scale.basis: Artistic target within museum-published genus range approximately0.5–3.5m; not measured AMNH7003 or displayed specimen length.

uncertainties: Exact soft-tissue thickness over crossbars and membrane outline are unknown; boss relief is conservative stylization, not claimed exposed bone.
Whole-body surface, posture and colour inferred from skeleton; no claim fossil colour.
Exact specimen scale unverified; genus-size artistic target declared. Display contains restored bones, not all anatomy claimed original fossil.
